title: Hearty Indulgent American Mung Bean Sprout Casserole
description: A rich and savory casserole featuring mung bean sprouts, perfect for a comforting dinner, this dish is ayurvedic tamasic friendly and avoids overly stimulating ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic in olive oil until the onion is translucent.
Add the mung bean sprouts to the skillet and cook until they are slightly tender.
In a large bowl, whisk together the ground mustard, egg, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked mung bean sprout mixture, shredded cheddar cheese, and whole wheat breadcrumbs to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is set.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
